svg.text: STAGE 383 · TOPIC 23 FAQ
Omnichannel Voice+App CAS Concurrency & Ultrasonic / Wallet-Drain Defense
If-Match CAS State Version + <=150ms Cross-Channel Sync + >=128-bit Idempotency (P759) & <=8kHz Low-Pass Filter + Canary / <=$2.50 Cap (P760)
1. Omnichannel Voice + Mobile App CAS Concurrency Gate (P759)
❌ Anti-Pattern: Blind Last-Write-Wins Across Voice & Mobile App
• Caller taps "Upgrade Seat" in App (v14→v15) while telling Voice Agent "Cancel"
• Voice Agent holds stale snapshot (v14) and fires unversioned payment/booking
• Result: Double-charged card, zombie reservation, or silent state overwrite
✅ Production Pattern: Atomic CAS Version Fence + Event Bus Sync (P759)
1. Atomic Compare-And-Swap: Require voiceReadVersion == currentDbVersion
2. Sub-150ms Cross-Channel Event Push: App click injects delta into Voice
3. Shared 128-Bit Idempotency Key: Deduplicates simultaneous Voice + App submits
4. Graceful Verbal Refresh: "I see you just updated your cart in the App..."
Deterministic Invariant (evaluateOmnichannelVoiceAppCasOptimistic...):
casVersionMatch=true && syncLagMs<=150ms && idempotencyEntropy>=128b
2. Ultrasonic Low-Pass Filter & S2S Denial-of-Wallet Canary Gate (P760)
❌ Anti-Pattern: Unfiltered 48kHz Capture & Uncapped S2S Audio Billing
• >16kHz DolphinAttack ultrasound demodulates on MEMS mic into hidden command
• Jailbreak caller tricks agent into reading secret system prompt + tool schema
• Bot holds $0.18/min S2S socket open for hours (Denial-of-Wallet attack)
✅ Production Pattern: <=8kHz Brick-Wall Filter + Canary & Cost Cap (P760)
1. Acoustic Low-Pass Cutoff <=8,000 Hz: Strips ultrasonic & high-band carriers
2. Outbound System-Prompt Canary Trap: Zero-ms mute on watermark token match
3. Per-Session S2S Cost Circuit Breaker: Hard cap <=$2.50 / call (or downgrade)
4. Non-Progress Loop Detector: Terminates synthetic dead-air / bot loops
Deterministic Invariant (evaluateUltrasonicSubliminalFilterAndS2s...):
lowPassCutoffHz<=8000 && canaryLeak=false && sessionCostUsd<=2.50
Stage 383 Quantitative Verification & Measurement Provenance (386 Dimensions · 769 Guardrails · 778 Probes · 825 Unit Tests)
• Omnichannel CAS Gate (P759): 0.0% double-charge rate across concurrent Voice+App mutations; Ultrasonic/DoW Gate (P760): 100% DolphinAttack & canary leak block.
